text:
ashley: kicking off v2.14.0 canary -> 3% traffic now. warmup window 10m, tagging @samir @katie for QA smoke.

deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.14.0 -> 3% traffic. instances=12 region=us-west-2.

samir: seeing a couple 5xx in the initial window, pulling logs now — sending short snippet.

ashley: logs below from one canary pod (truncated):
```
E 13:22:17 inference/runtime.go:213 request failed: kvcache: alloc failed: out of memory
stack: goroutine 842 [running]:
...
```

jia: perf note: latency p95 +40ms on long prompt paths (not huge) but correlated with the same canary pod.

sre-bot: Alert cleared: pod abc123 restarted due to OOM, new pod abc123-2 healthy. autoscaler adjusted replicas from 11 -> 12.

katie: QA: hallucination regression on identity prompt set. failing 5/30 tests. uploading examples: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 (sensitive redacted)

ashley: hmm. prefer to HOLD at 3% for now and pin sensitive routes to v2.13.2 while we investigate. can we pin /payments and /billing?

samir: applying route pin now. config patch:
```json
{
  "route_pins": [
    {"route": "/payments/*", "version": "v2.13.2"},
    {"route": "/billing/*", "version": "v2.13.2"}
  ]
}
```

ashley: good. if failures keep increasing within next 5m we'll rollback. otherwise aim to fix kvcache config and consider a 10% push.

deploy-bot: Route pins applied. traffic still at 3%. no new 5xx in last 2m. canary instances=12.

katie: re-run QA after pin -> regressions down to 1/30. recommend proceed to 10% after a 15m bake and kv cache patch to guard allocations.

ashley: ok folks — agree to move to 10% in 15m unless p95 > +25% or error rate > 0.5% across canary. please react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.

samir: :thumbsup:

jia: :thumbsup: will keep a close eye on p95 and KV cache metrics.

ashley: action items: 1) samir apply kvcache heap limits (in progress), 2) katie continue QA sweeps, 3) jia monitor p95. i'll trigger the 10% shift when checks pass. if anything spikes we rollback to v2.13.2 and open a postmortem.
